text:
anya: Quick heads-up — we're starting a staged rollout of the 'prefetch-harmony' runtime change to 60% of prod capacity tonight (22:00 UTC). Canary numbers look promising: p50 down ~18%, token cost down ~28% for our chat-heavy traffic. p99 is stable (+2ms on tail in worst windows).

matt: Nice! Which model families/workloads were in the canary?

anya: Mainly chat-medium (redwood-chat-3b and open-chat-6b variants) plus mixed burst traffic from the search rerank route. We intentionally excluded very long-seq generation and embedding-only routes for this wave.

jia: What are the rollback/alert thresholds? If p99 regresses >10% or error-rate bump >0.3% we stop the rollout and flip the flag. Also watch CPU/GPU power spikes for the first 2 hours.

anya: Exactly. Rollout is gated by the canary alarm policy:
```
prefetch_harmony.enabled=true
canary_thresholds: { p50_delta: -5%, p99_delta: +10%, error_rate_delta: +0.3% }
```
If any threshold hits we auto-scale down canary and page SRE.

corey: We ran a quick customer-impact pass — one small partner on legacy-client saw a +40ms p50 on a handful of requests (root cause: their requests are extremely prefix-heavy and we triggered a less-optimal prefetch plan). I opened a ticket: infra-4567.

anya: Thanks Corey — noted. We'll push a targeted config override for prefix-heavy routes (prefetch_harmony.strategy=kv-fallback) and keep them out of the main canary until validated.

srebot: [ALERT @channel] Canary rollout started at 22:00 UTC; canary_id=pharmony-2026-03-23-1; monitors enabled.

anya: Timeline: 22:00 start -> 60% for 3 hours -> evaluate metrics -> 22:00-01:00 gradual increase to 100% if green. Owners: @anya (runtime), @matt (benching), @jia (SLO guardrails). Please monitor p50/p99, token cost, GPU utilization, and the new prefetch hit-rate dashboard: https://dash.redwood/prefetch-harmony-canary (internal).

matt: I'll post a short bench report (p50/p99/cost breakdown) in ~90m. If anyone sees odd regressions, tag the thread and ping SRE. :tada:

anya: Minor follow-ups: update the runbook section "Rollouts -> Prefetch Harmony" and add the config snippet for route-level overrides. Thanks team — go/no-go check at 01:05 UTC.

jia: Added the runbook note and the rollback play in runbooks/rollouts.md.

corey: infra-4567 is scoped and I've attached logs + a minimal repro. We'll validate the strategy override before expanding the canary.

anya: Great. Closing loop after the 01:05 decision.
